resources.string: Open the Helux Tunnel panel on your computer, turn the tunnel ON, then press “Pair device (QR)” and scan the code shown there. The first code you scan sets the server; later codes must match it.
The code is only valid until DSH restarts. It works like a password - never share a screenshot of it.
Point the camera at the QR code in the Helux Tunnel panel.
The camera is used only to read the pairing QR code. Nothing is uploaded and no photo is saved.
Could not start the camera on this device.
This device is no longer paired
DSH rejected the saved session, usually because the pairing expired or DSH was reset. Scan a new QR code to pair again.
